title: Design System: Zanchin Content Shoot Booking

section-title.purpose: One per card, the '01 Your Details'-style numbered header.

label.purpose: Form field labels only — the sole uppercase+tracked role in the system.

body.purpose: Input values and default reading text.

control.purpose: Button and list-control text (calendar days, time slots, suggestion cards, duration ticks).

caption.purpose: Sub-labels inside controls: slot status, duration sub-line, legend.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover and selected states on any interactive control. Never applied at rest.

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: Text inputs at rest, reading as a recessed slot. Never used for disabled controls — those use opacity alone.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The six numbered card containers only — permanent, one elevation tier above raised.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Signal Blue hover/focus ring. Paired with 'raised' on hover; paired with 'pressed' on input focus; never paired with a selected fill.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/selected state changes across calendar days, list controls, and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button (Confirm Booking)
components.description: Full-width Onyx primary action button — one per card, the single next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; background: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; border-radius: 9px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(58,123,213,.28); outline: none; }

components.name: List Control — resting
components.description: Shared pattern for calendar days, time-slot rows, and suggestion cards at rest: flat, bordered, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-list-control { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; background: #e8eaed; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); color: #8a8f9a; border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 13px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all .16s ease; } .ds-list-control-status { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .65; } .ds-list-control:hover { color: #1a1a1a; border-color: #3a7bd5; box-shadow: 5px 5px 12px rgba(170,176,190,.5), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.92), 0 0 0 2px rgba(58,123,213,.28); }

components.name: List Control — selected
components.description: The one selected-state formula: solid Onyx fill + raised shadow, no ring, no leftover status dot.
components.css: .ds-list-control--selected { background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 5px 5px 12px rgba(170,176,190,.5), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.92); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Pressed-in text field — the one place `pressed` shadow is used outside cards.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #e8eaed; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); color: #1a1a1a; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(170,176,190,.4), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.88); transition: box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3a7bd5; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(170,176,190,.4), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.88), 0 0 0 3px rgba(58,123,213,.28); }

components.name: Numbered Card
components.description: The six top-level form sections — permanent elevation, an Onyx numbered badge, one Section Title.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f0f2f5; border-radius: 26px; box-shadow: 8px 8px 20px rgba(160,168,185,.4), -5px -5px 14px rgba(255,255,255,.95); padding: 26px 26px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); } .ds-card-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-card-badge { width: 28px; height: 28px; background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.3px; }

narrative.overview: This is a control panel, not a marketing surface. Every surface reads like a soft-pressed physical console: pale grey planes with dual light/dark shadows implying real depth, buttons that visibly lift under the cursor and press flat when chosen. It's built for a small, fixed roster of strategists who use it a few times a week to reserve a real studio slot against a real calendar — precision and operator confidence matter more than warmth or delight. Depth comes from one consistent shadow vocabulary, never from stacking effects — the moment two different signals (a fill color, a glow ring, a status dot) all claim to mean 'this is selected' at once, the console stops reading as precise and starts reading as noisy.
keyCharacteristics: Soft neumorphic surfaces — dual light/dark box-shadows are the entire elevation vocabulary.
Flat at rest, shadow as response — a control only carries a shadow when hovered, selected, or the one primary action.
Onyx is the single 'selected' color; Signal Blue means 'your focus is here,' never 'this is chosen.'
Dark theme swaps the entire accent role to orange rather than keeping Onyx.

rules.name: The One Selected Rule
rules.body: "Selected" has exactly one visual formula everywhere it appears — solid Onyx fill, white text, the resting-elevation shadow. Never a glow ring on top of a fill. Never a status dot surviving under a fill.

rules.name: The Dark-Theme Swap Rule
rules.body: Dark theme repoints --accent/--neon to orange rather than keeping Onyx, since near-black has no contrast on a near-black background. Hardcoded hex instead of var(--accent) silently breaks in dark mode.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Once Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + letter-spacing marks exactly one thing: a form field label. Never apply it to buttons, captions, or titles.

rules.name: The Rest-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: No control gets a shadow it didn't earn through hover or selection. A grid of mostly-flat cells with two or three shadowed ones is legible; simultaneously-shadowed everything is not.

dos: Do treat Onyx fill as the single, exclusive signal for 'selected' or 'primary action.'
Do keep every interactive control flat at rest and add shadow only for hover/selected states.
Do use var(--accent)/var(--neon) rather than hardcoded hex so components inherit the dark-theme swap.
Do reserve uppercase + letter-spacing for form field labels only.
Do keep the three status colors scoped to availability dots only.
donts: Don't stack a shadow, a glow ring, and a status dot on the same selected element.
Don't apply the raised shadow to a control at rest.
Don't apply an inset shadow to disabled controls on top of reduced opacity.
Don't introduce a second 'primary' color alongside Onyx.
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard or enterprise PM-tool layout.
Don't mix font families or introduce a display/heading face.
